adjudication.rationale: In `embeddable-host.js.es6#save`, `props.category_id` is set from `categoryId`, which can be `null` for a new host if the admin doesn’t pick a category. The server (`Admin::EmbeddableHostsController#save_host`) explicitly defaults blank `category_id` to `SiteSetting.uncategorized_category_id` and saves successfully, but the client then runs `host.set('category', Discourse.Category.findById(this.get('categoryId')))` using the still-null `categoryId`. Since the save response/serializer only includes `category_id` (no embedded category object), the client won’t hydrate `host.category`, causing `{{category-badge host.category}}` to render empty until a reload.
